hero.subheadline: A decision within 24 hours, a fully online process, no endless paperwork.

problem.title: Traditional banks don't move at your pace.
problem.item1Body: While you wait for an answer, your projects don't wait.
problem.item2Body: Complex forms and rigid criteria that don't reflect your reality.
problem.item3Body: Every day of delay is a growth opportunity slipping by.

guide.title: We get it. That's why we built EspaceCredit.
guide.body: EspaceCredit is a Quebec-based company that designed a financing process for people in a hurry to move forward — not to be kept waiting. Clear amount, term, and payment from the start, a decision within 24 hours, and a team that supports you every step of the way.

plan.title: Three steps, no surprises.
plan.step1Body: Adjust the amount and term below, then submit your application online in minutes.
plan.step2Body: Our team reviews your file and gives you a clear answer, with visible status at every stage.
plan.step3Body: Sign your contract online and your deposit is scheduled automatically.
plan.imageAlt: Two colleagues collaborating on a laptop in a bright office

success.title: Your projects move forward. Your business grows.
success.body: No more waiting and uncertainty: you're back in control of your timeline and your decisions.
